== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|[[Lindon]]'s core is the physical location of his soul, situated just below his navel where all lines of [[madra]] connect. He typically visualizes it as a rolling sphere of blue-[[white light]]. While most individuals possess only one core, [[Lindon]] is unique in possessing two cores within a single body. His cores are characterized by exceptional density and quality, featuring exceptionally [[pure madra]] that allows him to perform specialized techniques and [[Soulsmithing]] tasks without tools. Throughout his progression, his cores have undergone various transformations, including a [[Copper]] core that was compressed and later transmuted into an [[Iron core]]. He also possesses a [[Blackflame core]]. The [[destruction]] of a core is considered a catastrophic event, often viewed as being worse than death, as it prevents an individual from working with [[scripts]] or [[Remnants]].}}
